title: Quantitative Aptitude for Competitive Examinations
author: R.S. Aggarwal
description: The gold standard textbook for Quantitative Aptitude in Bank PO, SSC, CAT, GATE, Placement & Railway exams.

chapters.title: 1. Number System
chapters.description: Extracted objective-type questions, options, and answer key from Chapter 1.

chapters.title: 2. H.C.F. and L.C.M. of Numbers
chapters.description: Standard objective problems on Prime Factorization, Highest Common Factor, and Lowest Common Multiple.

chapters.title: 3. Decimal Fractions
chapters.description: Objective problems on recurring decimals, simplification, and fractional operations.

chapters.title: 4. Simplification
chapters.description: BODMAS rule, Modulus, Vinculum, algebraic identities, and numerical simplification problems.

chapters.title: 5. Square Roots and Cube Roots
chapters.description: Square roots, cube roots, prime factorization, long division, radical multiplication/division, and perfect square/cube problems.

chapters.title: 6. Average
chapters.description: Arithmetic mean, weighted average, consecutive series, age/salary problems, speed averages, cricket run rates, and data sufficiency.

chapters.title: 7. Problems on Numbers
chapters.description: Number representation, consecutive numbers, digits and place values, two-digit/three-digit reversing, fractions and reciprocals.

chapters.title: 8. Problems on Ages
chapters.description: Age ratios, present, past and future ages, age differences, average age, and age-based algebraic equations.

chapters.title: 9. Surds and Indices
chapters.description: Laws of indices, definition of surds, order of surds, operations on surds, and exponential equations.

chapters.title: 10. Logarithms
chapters.description: Definition of logarithm, laws of logarithms, base change formula, common logarithms, characteristic and mantissa, logarithmic equations.

chapters.title: 11. Percentage
chapters.description: Percentage definitions, core conversion formulas, percentage increase/decrease, successive changes, commodity price neutrality, population growth & depreciation, demographic breakdowns, mixture percentages, and data sufficiency.

title: How to Prepare for Logical Reasoning for CAT
author: Arun Sharma
description: Comprehensive guide for Logical Reasoning, Seating Arrangements, Blood Relations, and Puzzles for CAT & Placement.

chapters.title: 1. Blood Relations & Family Trees
chapters.description: Coded blood relation puzzles, family tree diagrams, and relational reasoning.
